items.title: Delta Ups Its Bet on Austin with New Paris Flights
items.summary: Delta is throwing down the gauntlet in Austin, announcing plans to launch daily summer-seasonal flights to Paris next year as it vies for position as the Texas capital’s global airline.  When the flights start in March, Delta will be the only U.S. airline to fly to Europe from the fast-growing Texan city.  Delta has homed in on Austin’s concentration of affluent travelers that can feed into the airline’s loyalty program and co-branded credit card.

items.title: Why Delta and United’s Loyalty Programs Could Be Worth $30 Billion
items.summary: Air Canada sold the 25% Aeroplan program stake to Blackstone and some leading Canadian institutional investors, valuing the program at more than $7 billion U.S. dollars ($10 billion Canadian dollars), according to a news release Tuesday.  Based on the valuation of the Aeroplan stake, the Delta SkyMiles and United MileagePlus loyalty programs could each be worth $30 billion or more, which would be a significant chunk of each airline’s market values, Jefferies analyst Sheila Kahyaoglu wrote after the sale.
